desc: Following in the footsteps of its groundbreaking bigger brother, the Para Military 2 Salt, this remarkable expression of the Para 3 boasts a full flat-ground blade crafted from CPM MagnaCut a state-of-the-art particle metallurgy steel that offers an exceptional balance of edge retention, toughness, and superior corrosion resistance. The PlainEdge blade is cloaked in a non-reflective Diamond-Like Carbon (DLC) coating and paired with a handle featuring peel-ply-textured black G-10 scales machined with our distinctive Caribbean Bi-Directional Texture pattern. To complement its blade steel and low-profile finish, the knife's nested stainless steel liners, four-position pocket clip, and all other hardware are also crafted from marine grade materials and feature matching black coatings.
